# PreventionWeb

> PreventionWeb is a global knowledge platform for disaster risk reduction (DRR) managed by UNDRR, featuring community collaboration tools and regional initiatives like the ONEA-GETI platform for Northeast Asia.

PreventionWeb serves as the official repository for DRR knowledge, best practices, and community engagement, with dedicated regional platforms such as the PreventionWeb DRR Community Platform operated by UNDRR and the Office for Northeast Asia and Global Education and Training Institute (ONEA-GETI) based in Incheon.

## Key Topics

- Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR)
- UNDRR
- PreventionWeb
- ONEA-GETI
- Community Platform
- Northeast Asia
- Risk Management
- Disaster Prevention
- Knowledge Sharing
- Regional Initiatives

## Community Platform & Access

- [PreventionWeb DRR Community Platform - Login](https://cc.preventionweb.net/onea-geti): Login portal for PreventionWeb DRR community platform by UNDRR and ONEA-GETI, providing member authentication and access to collaborative disaster risk reduction resources for the Northeast Asia region.
